about.text: A historical Loiret farmhouse cheese, dusted with vine-shoot charcoal ash and sold in several styles. The pasteurised milk is inoculated with Penicillium candidum and ripened about 15 days in humid rooms. Genuine production in the Loiret is said to have ended, and cheeses sold as Olivet are now made elsewhere.

sources.text: Its history, its method and its current production.
